## Skill checklist

For new or modified skills:

- [ ] SKILL.md is under 3,000 words — detailed content is in `references/`
- [ ] Frontmatter description includes specific trigger phrases ("Use when...")
- [ ] Skill body is written as instructions for the agent (imperative, verb-first)
- [ ] No time-sensitive information (no version numbers, no "as of 2026")
- [ ] Consistent terminology throughout — no synonyms for the same concept
- [ ] `plugin.json` updated if a new skill was added
